description: Retrieve up to 20 deterministically ranked memory records for a query (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } with per-item { memory, score }. Scores up to 500 candidates in namespace by lexical match (0.55), salience (0.30), and 30-day freshness (0.15) multiplied by tier boost (core=1.5x, semantic=1.25x), excluding items below min_salience. Use when you need individual memory IDs, metadata, or scores (for inspection, feedback, or forget_memory); use build_context instead for a ready-to-inject <memory_context> block, or search_code for code symbols.

min_salience.description: Minimum salience filter (0.0-1.0); memories strictly below this value are excluded.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to search (defaults to "default"; never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Keywords or natural-language topic to match against stored memory content.

token_budget.description: Advisory token budget hint for downstream context sizing (default 4096).

name: recall_memories

total_candidates.description: Total candidate memories evaluated in the namespace.

title: Recall Memories
